reply.rationale: A small paradigm network is defensible for a subset of the codebook. I accepted only families with clear multi-entry compositional contrasts: lp-d/lp-b; tn-sim/tn-rot/tn-seq/tn-sweep; fn-sweep/fn-spot; bd-press/bd-rot; bl-ctr/bl-alt; drape-full/drape-face. In each accepted family, the same initial element recurs in a stable frame, the second slot shows substitution, and whole meanings are predictable from the parts. I rejected broader or looser segmentations elsewhere because shared letters or prefixes did not yield a coherent substitution class with consistent semantic role. All remaining symbols are treated as lexical wholes.
